title: Coordinate resampling disagreement probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and choose a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Draw an input $x$ from the product distribution with marginal $\pi$, then independently resample coordinate $i$ from $\pi$ while keeping the other coordinates fixed. The coordinate resampling disagreement probability is the probability that the two resulting values of $f$ differ.
